name: Spirit Box Strangers
source:
You, a paranormal investigator, go into an abandoned hospital in the middle of the night in order to satisfy your client. However, you end up meeting a chatty spirit.

[from [url=https://magbo.itch.io/spirit-box-strangers]itch.io[/url]]
